'''DU-3''' was a [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droid]],<ref name="CWA" /> a model of [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]],<ref name="CharEnc" /> that was on sale during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="CWA" /> from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Like all pit [[Droid/Legends|droids]], DU-3 was manufactured by [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc./Legends|Serv-O-Droid, Inc.]] and stood at 1.19 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] (3 [[Foot/Legends|ft]], 11 in) tall.<ref name="CharEnc" /> The droid had [[Color/Legends|brown]] plating and a blue [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. Despite its small stature, DU-3 was capable of causing a lot of trouble.<ref name="CWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Don't judge this diminutive droid by its size! There's a lot of trouble packed into that tiny frame!|In-game store description for DU-3|<ref name="CWA" />}}
DU-3 appeared as a purchasable droid companion for players in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] released by [[Sony|Sony Online Entertainment]] in [[2010]]. The droid could be purchased with the in-game currency "Station Cash" at a price of SC 269. This article makes no assumptions about if DU-3 was bought, as purchasing it is entirely optional.<ref name="CWA" />
